description: Skills the learner already possesses through education, projects, personal experiences, volunteering, extracurricular activities, or previous work.
Existing abilities that can be applied to the learner's target career.
Skills that are essential for entering the target role and should be learned first.
Skills that improve effectiveness and competitiveness but may not be essential for initial entry.
Skills that can be developed later after the learner has established the core capabilities required for the target role.
A practical project, portfolio item, assignment, certification, interview task, or other evidence demonstrating the skill.
